topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can’t believe this. I spent countless nights perfecting that essay, pouring my heart and soul into every single word. It was supposed to be my personal statement, a private insight into my dreams and fears. Now, it’s just floating out there, an open book for anyone to read. It’s supposed to be confidential, isn’t it? What kind of message does this send about how they handle sensitive information? I trusted them, and now my words are being used for who knows what. I need to find out exactly who made this decision and why. This isn’t just a breach of privacy; it’s a violation of trust. I deserve answers, and I’m going to make sure I get them.
